scope: Pokemon TCG Traditional Chinese (Taiwan): official card search asia.pokemon-card.com/tw vs CardScope DB (region TW), read-only. Text facts only, no images stored.

requests.note: The search page and one MF list page were fetched with curl; the rest with a Node script that reuses the URL builders and parsers of providers/pokemon-tw-official.mjs. The 796 series list pages count the MF page 1 a second time inside the script.

officialListFormat.expansionList: GET /tw/card-search/ : 136 checkbox rows (class expansionCode, value = code) with labels; 134 unique codes (SP5 appears 3 times with three V-UNION labels). Only the newest 20 expansions also appear as expansionLink tiles with release dates.
officialListFormat.cardLists: GET /tw/card-search/list/?expansionCodes=<code>&pageNo=N, 20 cards per page, page count in resultTotalPages; rarity via &rarity[]=<1..22>. Unchanged vs what providers/pokemon-tw-official.mjs parses.

newExpansionsNote: The official expansion code list (134) is identical to docs/evidence/pokemon-tw/official-expansion-names-20261003.json, and the card id sets of the 131 series in the 2026-10-02 cache are identical today. Newest release dates on the search page: MF and M6a 2026-09-16; nothing released after early October 2026 is listed.
